WOODPECKER_HOST.description: Public URL of this server (used for webhook callbacks)

WOODPECKER_GITHUB.description: Enable the GitHub forge (required — Woodpecker needs exactly one forge driver to boot). Set true to allow GitHub OAuth login; add WOODPECKER_GITHUB_CLIENT and WOODPECKER_GITHUB_SECRET for the login button to work.

WOODPECKER_GITHUB_CLIENT.description: GitHub OAuth App Client ID (enables login). Leave empty to start server without working login.

WOODPECKER_GITHUB_SECRET.description: GitHub OAuth App Client Secret (enables login).

WOODPECKER_AGENT_SECRET.description: Shared secret for agent-to-server authentication (auto-generated, do not change)
